JSON-Configured Portfolio Template – Developer Portfolio Giveaway: Change One JSON File to Update Everything

Stop wasting weeks building your portfolio from scratch. This high-performance React template is 100% data-driven: simply update one JSON file with your projects, social links, and skills to deploy immediately.

Designed for developers and engineering teams, JSON-Configured Portfolio Template accelerates implementation, eliminates repetitive development friction, and streamlines day-to-day coding workflows.

Key Features:
• Clone the repository from GitHub.
• Replace the data in src/data/portfolio.json with your own.
• Deploy to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for free.
• Clean, formatted JSON document representing your complete portfolio profile.

GitHub Repository: https://github.com/
